phrases.phrase: Enlistment applications waiting for a clerk to pick up
{title} has been sitting in the enlistment queue past the deadline with no clerk on it. Please pick it up.
Thanks for enlisting with the 7th Cavalry. Your application is still in the queue, and a member of the processing team will review it soon. You don't need to do anything for now.
Scan the enlistment queue for un-actioned applications

The XenForo user ID the reminder note is posted as. Default: 598.

How many hours an application may sit in the queue with no processing status on it before it is reminded. The minimum is 1 hour and the maximum is 720 (30 days); anything outside that range falls back to the default of 24. Too small a value would remind the whole queue at once, and too large a value would remind nothing at all, so both are refused rather than acted on.

The thread prefix IDs that ride alongside a processing status without being one, such as S1, RTC and the "!!!" modifier. Nothing is routed or suppressed by them; they are listed here only so the add-on can tell a prefix it has no opinion about from one nobody has told it about yet. A prefix on a queue thread that is listed neither here, nor as an in-processing status, nor as an enlistment type is reported once per scan so a status the configuration has not caught up with is visible. Enter one ID per line or separate with commas. Default: 66, 68, 110 (S1, RTC, "!!!").

The thread prefix IDs that mean a clerk has taken an application on. A queue thread carrying any of them is being worked and is never reminded, whoever put the prefix there and whether or not they still hold the seat. Do not list the enlistment type prefixes (57, 58) here: every application in the queue carries one, so listing them would stop the reminder firing at all. Enter one ID per line or separate with commas. Default: 53, 54, 55 (Hold, Approved, In Progress).

The forum node whose open applications the reminder scans (the Enlistment Papers queue). Only threads directly in this node are checked; the Completed and Denied child forums are left alone. Default: 325.

Roster position IDs alerted about un-actioned re-enlistments: by default the Re-Enlistment Processing Clerk and the Senior and Lead clerks. Holders are matched as a primary or a secondary seat. Enter one ID per line or separate with commas. Default: 579, 960, 1012.

The thread prefix IDs that mark a re-enlistment. A queue thread carrying one of these as its primary prefix is routed to the re-enlistment clerks. Enter one ID per line or separate with commas. Default: 58.

Roster position IDs alerted about un-actioned standard enlistments: by default the Enlistment Processing Clerk, Processing Clerk IT, and the Senior and Lead clerks. Holders are matched as a primary or a secondary seat. Enter one ID per line or separate with commas. Default: 579, 580, 751, 1012.

The thread prefix IDs that mark a standard enlistment. A queue thread carrying one of these as its primary prefix is routed to the standard clerks. Enter one ID per line or separate with commas. Default: 57.
Enlistment Reminder
Reminds the processing team about enlistment applications that have sat in the queue past the deadline with no processing status on them.
